column1: # Tab-separated: id, group, proto, mix, cache, concurrency.
# Every row runs both libraries (dl-client and hk-client) against the same
# responder, so a row is a head-to-head pair. `--variants` selects rows by
# group or by id. Use 0 in the concurrency column to take --concurrency.
# cold: distinct names, upstream TTL 0. warm: shared names, upstream TTL 3600,
# valid only if the upstream saw no query during the measurement.
